items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: I played a lot of Herbert Clark stuff, a lot of that.

ctx.x: Something like Herbie Clark type solo.
How did you remember that? How did you think of that? Herbie Clark. You sure know -- yeah, I played a lot of Herbert Clark stuff, a lot of that.
At that point, were there a lot of black trumpet players? There couldn't have been too many playing classical music.
